title: Duarte Nursery, Inc.
description:
Duarte Nursery, Inc. is a wholesale deciduous fruit and nut tree nursery in Hughson, California — an S Corporation run by brothers John and Jeff Duarte.

The dataset is the company's complete digital footprint:

300–500 full Social Security numbers from California DE9 quarterly employment tax filings (2024 Q1 through 2026 Q2).
The owners' complete identity packages — John Duarte: SSN 545-67-5279, DOB 9/9/1966, DL C3261756, BofA account 325107115395. Jeff Duarte: SSN 545675712, DOB 7/19/1969.
Bank account and routing numbers for ~100 employees via NACHA ACH direct deposit files — plus the company's own BofA commercial account credentials and wire transfer instructions.
Two years of reviewed financial statements showing the company is <redacted>
Privileged litigation documents from active lawsuits including P2G class certification strategy and settlement documents.
Proprietary rootstock and grafting data — the IP that differentiates Duarte from competing Central Valley nurseries.
Complete salary and compensation data for 23 salaried employees, insurance coverage details, tax returns, and 401(k) census information.
